target: Implement a check-only PR Steward v1 intake that harvests pull request metadata, changed files, commits/head SHA, reviews, review comments, review threads, issue comments, and check/CI state; classifies every review item; emits MERGE_READINESS.json and companion ledgers; and fails closed on unknown reviewers/bots, unclassified items, unresolved blocking threads, failed checks, or stale proof.
invariants: Do not auto-merge or mutate merge queues.
Fail closed when reviewers, bots, threads, checks, or proof freshness cannot be proven.
Treat AUTO_APPLIED as a disposition value only unless a future packet explicitly authorizes edit behavior.

pr.title: feat(pr-steward): add check-only review intake
pr.body:
## Summary
- Implements PR Steward v1 as a check-only intake over GitHub PR metadata, reviews, review comments, review threads, issue comments, and CI state.
- Emits MERGE_READINESS.json plus review item, thread disposition, and CI triage ledgers.
- Fails closed on unknown reviewers/bots, unclassified review items, unresolved blocking threads, failed required checks, stale proof, or GitHub auth/API uncertainty.

## Scope
Check-only read and classification flow. No active GitHub mutation, auto-fix, thread resolution, auto-merge, merge queue mutation, or secret storage.

## Validation
Run JSON parse checks, focused unit tests, compileall for tools/tests, git diff --check, and proof freshness checks against PR head SHA.

## NOT_RUN
No live PR mutation and no merge queue mutation by design.

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, branch, GitHub auth, schema files, and PR Steward governance docs.
validation: GitHub auth is available or packet stops before live harvest.
Schema and governance docs are present.

steps.task: Harvest PR metadata, changed files, commits/head SHA, reviews, review comments, review threads, issue comments, and check/CI state without mutation.
requirements: Do not post comments, apply suggestions, resolve threads, approve, merge, or enqueue.
Record command outputs and exit codes.
validation: Every required PR surface has either harvested data or an explicit UNKNOWN blocker.
No GitHub mutation command is present in the implementation.

steps.task: Classify every harvested review item and thread into allowed dispositions.
validation: Unknown reviewer or bot produces UNKNOWN_REVIEWER_NEEDS_CLASSIFICATION and blocks readiness.
AUTO_APPLIED is emitted only when a human-applied or pre-existing fix is observed; the tool does not apply it.

steps.task: Emit MERGE_READINESS.json, REVIEW_ITEM_LEDGER.json, THREAD_DISPOSITIONS.json, and CI_TRIAGE.json.
validation: mutation_performed is false in every output.
Readiness is NOT_READY or NEEDS_SUPERVISOR when any blocker is present.
Proof records exact commands, outputs, exit codes, and PR head SHA.
